findings.title: Lookalike bank login page
findings.impact: The page imitates a trusted banking login, increasing credential phishing risk.
findings.recommendation: Block the page and warn users before credential entry.
findings.limitations: This finding is based on a lookalike domain pattern and may be a benign marketing domain.

checks.detail: Registrable domain matched a high-risk keyword dictionary.

precautions: Do not enter credentials on untrusted pages.
limitations: This result is a heuristic assessment and not a guarantee of malicious intent.
